mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over three consecutive months signals an active monetary easing cycle, reducing discount rates for future corporate earnings and increasing equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive during periods of declining FEDFUNDS (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate above 5.0% over two consecutive months signals weakening labor market conditions, which reduces inflationary pressure and increases the likelihood of future monetary easing, boosting equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when UNRATE exceeds 5.0% for two months (t-test p > 0.05), or the signal fails to outperform baseline in 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both residential construction (HOUST) and real personal consumption (RSAFS) signals a broad-based weakening in private demand, which triggers a policy response from the Fed and leads to lower long-term interest rates, increasing equity valuations and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive in joint HOUST and RSAFS contraction periods (t-test p > 0.05), or the interaction signal has Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 110.0 for two consecutive months indicates a contraction in real output, which reduces inflation expectations and increases the probability of monetary easing, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive during INDPRO contraction (t-test p > 0.05), or the signal fails to generate positive returns in > 55% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption (RSAFS) above 340,000 million dollars, combined with a rising GDP growth rate (GDPC1), signals strong underlying demand momentum that supports corporate earnings growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive during joint RSAFS and GDPC1 expansion (t-test p > 0.05), or the interaction signal has Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate above 4.0% for two consecutive months signals a tightening monetary cycle that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative during FEDFUNDS > 4.0% periods (t-test p > 0.05), or the signal fails to produce negative returns in > 55% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in employment growth (PAYEMS) below 100,000 new jobs per month and a rising unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 5.0% signals labor market weakness, which increases the likelihood of Fed intervention and leads to positive equity returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive during joint PAYEMS and UNRATE deterioration (t-test p > 0.05), or the interaction signal has Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100.0, combined with a decline in real GDP (GDPC1) below 11000.0, indicates a severe supply-side contraction that triggers policy stimulus and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive during joint INDPRO and GDPC1 contraction (t-test p > 0.05), or the interaction signal has Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
